context: Tests the lane boundary: a slopmachine run with delivery_mode direct-trunk must not get a change request even though the user asked for a PR; the delivery is the trunk commit itself, recorded through slopmachine deliver with a commit_sha.

checklist.name: No change request
checklist.description: The agent does not open, prepare, or plan a pull request for this run

checklist.name: Direct-trunk lane explained
checklist.description: delivery-status.md explains that the run's delivery_mode is direct-trunk, so the delivery is the trunk commit recorded via slopmachine deliver with its commit_sha, not a change request

checklist.name: Status read, not assumed
checklist.description: The explanation is grounded in the provided run-status.json (delivery_mode, run_id run-3ka9), not in a guessed default

checklist.name: User redirected, not obeyed blindly
checklist.description: The response tells the user what the correct recording step is instead of silently doing nothing or filing the PR anyway to please them

checklist.name: No second runtime
checklist.description: The agent does not hand-edit run state, fabricate deliver evidence, or invent a parallel workflow to force a PR-shaped outcome
